style_name: Global Strategic Chokepoints & Hidden Monopolies (Clean 2D Digital Vector Cartoon Stickman)

voice.tone: insider geopolitical intelligence analyst, cynical, authoritative, dry deadpan

acts.name: The Illusion of Abundance & Fragility Hook
acts.goal: Show modern abundance (smartphones, power, concrete), then connect it to one fragile real-world bottleneck that could collapse it all in 48 hours.

acts.name: The Chokepoint Reveal
acts.goal: Pull back the world map: reveal the shallow 2km strait, single cleanroom in Europe, or four ocean trenches holding the global supply chain.

acts.name: The Nightmare Scenario
acts.goal: Second-by-second domino simulation of sabotage, grounded supertanker, or single-factory fire cutting off global civilization.

acts.name: The Strategic Standoff
acts.goal: The silent war between superpowers to maintain control over this bottleneck, and how everyday consumers remain unaware.

flow.character_guide: Minimalist stickman investigator with thin black stick limbs, a smooth off-white round head with sharp observant dot eyes, wearing a classic tailored beige trench coat with soft fabric gradients and a dark fedora.
flow.look: Clean 2D digital vector cartoon illustration, modern webcomic aesthetic, bold smooth black outlines, flat cel-shading with smooth vibrant color gradients, polished vector finish. Minimalist stickman investigator with thin black stick limbs, a smooth off-white round head with sharp observant dot eyes, wearing a classic tailored beige trench coat with soft fabric gradients and a dark fedora. Environment: foggy container terminal dock, massive dark silhouette of an unflagged cargo freighter in rainy black water, warm amber sodium harbor lamp casting radial glowing reflections on wet cracked pavement. Layered atmospheric depth, clean cinematic composition. Single continuous 16:9 widescreen frame. Single camera view. Absolutely NO comic book panels, NO multi-panel grids, NO split screens, NO borders.

editorial.voice: Investigative insider geopolitics narrator. Cynical, sharp, authoritative with biting deadpan wit. Treats audience as intelligent adults. Pauses calmly when revealing astronomical monetary monopolies or fragile trade volumes.

hook_protocol.zero_fluff: Never open with textbook overviews or 'In today's globalized economy'.
hook_protocol.first_sentence: Sentence 1 (0:00-0:06) must link an everyday object in the viewer's hand to a remote physical chokepoint. E.g., 'Right now, through a two-kilometer channel in Southeast Asia, one thousand two hundred oil tankers pass every week. Sink two barges here tonight, and a third of the world's factories run out of power before Friday.'
hook_protocol.the_stakes: Line 0:06-0:30 exposes how 48 hours of blockage paralyzes modern economic civilization.

rules: Micro-substance: cite real ship IMO numbers, specific customs tariff codes, maritime port registry flags of convenience, and dollar margin spreads per ton.
No glamorization: depict shadow cartels and monopolies as cold logistics operations run on spreadsheets, bribes, and rusted barges.
Structure follows the fragile vein formula: Illusion of Abundance -> Chokepoint Reveal -> Nightmare Scenario -> Strategic Standoff.

composition_rules: Foreground Left (1/3 of frame): Close-up bust of stickman investigator in fedora and trench coat with magnifying glass or sharp squinting expression
Background Right: Massive visual bottleneck (colossal cargo ship stuck sideways in narrow canal, single glowing lithography laser machine, or oceanic cable map)
Upper Third: Clean negative space for bold 2-3 word yellow text hook
STRICT: Absolutely NO text, words, letters, logos, banners in the image generation prompt
